annotations.title: Russian retail fuel prices (AI-92/95/98, diesel) — Rosstat weekly averages

description:
Russian retail fuel prices (AI-92/95/98, diesel) — Rosstat weekly averages. Average retail pump prices across Russia from Rosstat's weekly release (rosstat.gov.ru nedel_sred_cen.xlsx): price (RUB/l), as_of, week-over-week change, 4-week and year-to-date change and `weeks` of history per fuel. Rosstat publishes weekly (usually Wednesday, prices as of Monday); cached 6 h, a stale copy (stale: true) is served for up to 14 days if Rosstat is unreachable.

GET /ru/fuel — price $0.003 USDC per call, paid automatically via x402 on Base (only successful responses are charged; 400/404/502 are free).

weeks.description: Weekly history points to include per fuel (0-52, default 4) Default: 4.
